# Afsnit 348: C25-aktierne vurderes, NVIDIA i comeback

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-11-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish episode (Hansen & Larsen) in which Per grades the Q3 reports of the C25 companies. On the global side the hosts cover Nvidia's sharp rally after Jensen Huang returned, and they warn about circular AI financing and how concentrated global portfolios are in the US. Per is broadly positive on Q3, with 7 as his typical grade: Genmab gets top marks for its data, FLSmidth is strong operationally but hurt by bad management handling, and Novo Nordisk, Sydbank, Royal Unibrew and GN Store Nord get positive mentions. DSV and Coloplast are at the bottom of his grades.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GMAB — Genmab | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Per's top-graded company, with three strong data sets; it is Helge's largest position, held in his pension.

#### Reasoning

Per ranks Genmab first for 'data, data, data': three data sets that knocked the legs out from under the sceptics worried about what Genmab will earn when its royalty agreement expires in 3-4 years. Helge has held it as his largest position for years and plans to keep it in his pension, based on phase 1-3 data across several cancer indications.

#### Sell Triggers

- if phase 3 data disappoint
- if pipeline fails to offset royalty expiry

> *"helt i toppen er helt i toppen, der har jeg Genmap"*

---

### 🟢 FLS — FLSmidth | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Near-top grade and strong delivery, but the stock fell 15-20% after a weak capital markets day and the CFO firing.

#### Reasoning

Per thinks FLSmidth delivered very well financially as a pure mining machinery company after selling its cement unit. The fall came from medium-term growth targets below consensus and the clumsy firing of the CFO just before the capital markets day. That gap between results and share price suggests the drop is overdone, though management credibility is a concern.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stays below consensus
- if more management missteps
- if commodity prices fall further

> *"Et andet selskab, som også får topkarakter, de får ikke helt en 12 og lidt ligesom Genvap, det er jo FL Smith."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

'Best comeback' report, yet the stock gave back its gains; it needs to break the resistance at 293.

#### Reasoning

Per graded the report as better than its reception: 2026 has gone from guided declines to possibly flat. The pill rollout and manufacturing capacity look on track. Investors still trade it rather than own it. Per wants a break above about 293, a level where it has turned down several times, and Helge buys more on dips.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rejected again at 293 resistance
- if pill rollout falters

> *"Vi skal helst op over de 2,93"*

---

### 🟠 SYDB — Sydbank | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Best bank report, with improving ROE and a smooth merger with Arbejdernes Landsbank.

#### Reasoning

Sydbank delivered the best C25 bank report, with ROE just over 14% and moving towards its targets. Integration of Arbejdernes Landsbank is going well, with costs being cut. The big IT synergies are still to be proven.

#### Sell Triggers

- if IT synergies fail to materialise
- if ROE improvement stalls

> *"Sydbank eller AL Sydbank, som den fjerde leverede det bedste bankregnskab"*

---

### 🟠 GN — GN Store Nord | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Positive surprise and buyback after the hearing sale, but it still needs steady revenue growth.

#### Reasoning

The sale of the hearing business brings about DKK 12bn, leaves GN debt-free and funds a DKK 1bn buyback with more to come. Per says investors stay hesitant until GN shows 5-8% annual growth in Enterprise, gaming and military. Management has promised no large acquisitions. Both hosts will follow it quarter by quarter.

#### Sell Triggers

- if large acquisition announced
- if revenue growth fails to reach 5-8%
- if negative surprises return

> *"Den positive overraskelse i det her kvartal, det prædikat, det tildeler jeg GN Stor Nord"*

---

### 🟠 DSV — DSV | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Average report and a rally on low expectations; rebuilding trust will take time.

#### Reasoning

Per gave DSV a moderate 4. The 15% rise reflected expectations that had collapsed, not strong results. The restarted buyback and the plan to win back lost contracts by summer 2027 lower the risk premium. Helge says it needs a patient investor while the large acquisition is integrated.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further integration/delivery problems in Germany
- if contract recovery by 2027 fails

> *"Den første, det var, at jeg giver et moderat fiertal til DSV."*

---

### 🟠 COLO-B — Coloplast | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Disappointing report with lower ROIC targets, but investors are betting the bottom is in.

#### Reasoning

Per put Coloplast at the bottom: soft earnings and a lower 2030 ROIC target after the overpriced Atos and Kerecis deals. The stock rose because investors hope expectations have been reset and the new CEO can beat them, the 'Demant model'. That still needs to be delivered.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Kerecis reimbursement changes hurt earnings
- if goodwill impairments

> *"Helt i bunden, Helge, der ligger Coloplast."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Huge swings after Jensen Huang's return; the hosts flag circular vendor financing and governance concerns.

#### Reasoning

Helge says alarm bells are ringing because Nvidia lends customers money to buy its own chips, a value chain that is too interconnected. Per advises thinking carefully about AI exposure and watching stress indicators such as the VIX to tell whether a sell-off is a buying opportunity.

#### Sell Triggers

- if circular financing unwinds
- if AI capex slows

> *"Altså det her med Nvidia, de låner kunden penge, så de kan betale deres chip"*

---
